Pinned frontend dependencies (served locally; no CDN or font network requests).

https://unpkg.com/react@18.3.1/umd/react.production.min.js
https://unpkg.com/react-dom@18.3.1/umd/react-dom.production.min.js

Babel standalone 7.26.9, MIT license (babel-LICENSE.txt):
https://unpkg.com/@babel/standalone@7.26.9/babel.min.js

Babel compiles console.jsx in the browser, preserving the existing no-build
workflow. License notices embedded in distributed files are retained.
